scope: 50 low plants; IDs109 and124 remain the approved representative-sample artwork
art_direction: Botanical silhouettes, curved individual foliage, closed fleshy organs, readable species-specific flower structures and independently proportioned growth stages. Existing animation, lighting and performance configuration are unchanged.

geometry_conventions.coordinates: metres, Blender Z up; caller preserves existing maximum height and planting footprint
geometry_conventions.growth: Seedlings have few primary organs; juveniles add crowns, branches, pads or offsets with proportionally broader young foliage. Buds use mature attachment positions.
geometry_conventions.anchors: Every mature reproductive/tip vertex and every bud vertex has a fruit_anchors entry; mature and bud attachment sets match.
geometry_conventions.succulents: All foliage mesh components are closed; all material palette wind flags are False; young tissues use the label youngflesh.
geometry_conventions.textures: Uses existing materials and authored sample tissue textures via caller. No reference photographs are copied into assets.

validation.method: Pure geometry generation for all three ages, using a small mathutils Vector stand-in. Blender export and visual checks performed by the parent workflow.
checks: two incident faces per succulent foliage edge
